featured_reviews.name: PRASAD PRABHU
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been visiting Shiv Stationery and Xerox for quite some time now and every visit has been smooth and pleasant. The shop is very well-organized you will find everything from pens, notebooks and art supplies to files and project materials without having to search too much.

What I really appreciate is how quick and efficient their Xerox and printing service is. Even during busy hours, the staff manage things patiently and make sure the work is done neatly. Once, I had some urgent printouts and spiral binding to be done just before a submission deadline and they helped me get everything ready in time without any hassle.

The prices are reasonable and they don’t overcharge for small things, which makes a big difference compared to many other shops. The owner is polite and approachable and it feels nice to shop at a place where they actually care about customer satisfaction.

Overall, Shiv Stationery and Xerox is a reliable go-to shop for stationery, Xerox and printing needs. Highly recommended for students, professionals or anyone looking for good service with a personal touch!

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent shop for all stationery and printing needs! The staff is very polite, quick, and helpful. Photocopy and print quality is always clear and accurate. Highly recommended!
